propositions: The complexity baseline file has no CI lock equivalent to the module-size limit lock, allowing any contributor to modify it without administrator oversight
New complexity entries can be added to the baseline without triggering gate failures because the test only validates count matching and stale entries, not entry count monotonicity

The baseline lock must perform semantic comparison (entry removal or lowering allowed, entry addition or ceiling raise rejected) rather than byte-equality comparison to enable legitimate shrinkage without override
The CI lock must fail closed when the base copy from main cannot be fetched, preventing unverified baseline changes from passing due to flaky git operations
Adding a new high-complexity function paired with a matching baseline entry in the same change must fail CI to prevent baseline bloat
